transcript:
MARTIN: Hold on...

[SFX: We hear rustling of papers on Martin's side]

MARTIN: OK, got some info on your doctor here. Want me to read it out?

DAVID: Yeah, man.

MARTIN: Not got much here, but Fausto Kaufer... Came to America in 1949... Jesus... He was part of Operation Paperclip.

DAVID: Paperclip?

MARTIN: Yeah. All it says other that that is that he was born March 16th, 1911... 

DAVID: Not even a specialty?

MARTIN: Nope... Ah well, we can delve into it more when you get back. What else is in your file?

[SFX: As DAVID reads, his voice fades out and into Dr. Kaufer's]

DAVID: “Patient 3538. Suffering audio and visual hallucinations. Despite many adjustments to his medications, he still suffers symptoms... Patient believes the ghosts of former patients are here telling him about a demon who he is in mortal danger from. A curious aspect is the fact that one of the voices he hears is not human. He hears what he believes are calls from an animal. A chimpanzee to be specific. When questioned about it, he described it as a formless electrical entity made of blue light... He says it screams to him when he is in danger... Patient recommended for scourging for the December tribute.” What the...? Tribute?

Whoa, that's dark.
